name: NocoDB
description:
Connect Claude to NocoDB and work with your structured data directly from your conversations.

The NocoDB MCP connector gives Claude secure access to your NocoDB Base, allowing it to understand your data structure and interact with tables, fields, views, and records.

With the connector, you can ask Claude to:

• Explore tables, fields, and views
• Search, filter, and retrieve records
• Create and update records
• Analyze and summarize data
• Work with structured data using natural language
• Understand relationships and context across your NocoDB data

Use NocoDB with Claude to turn your existing data into an interactive base for research, reporting, operations, project management, CRM workflows, and other data-driven tasks.

Access is governed by your NocoDB account and base permissions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add NocoDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add NocoDB to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.nocodb.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the NocoDB MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: NocoDB provides these MCP tools: aggregate, countRecords, createRecords, deleteRecords, getBaseInfo, getRecord, getTableSchema, getTablesList, queryRecords, readAttachment, and updateRecords.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to NocoDB?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to NocoDB in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
NocoDB requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
NocoDB is developed by NocoDB. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
